test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They will not tolerate procedural anomalies.

options.text: Procedural anomalies will not be tolerated by them.
Procedural anomalies are not being tolerated by them.
Procedural anomalies would not be tolerated by them.
Procedural anomalies have not been tolerated by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They will not tolerate procedural anomalies."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Procedural anomalies" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will not tolerate" to "will not be tolerated" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the objective case of the original subject, "them."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Procedural anomalies will not be tolerated by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Procedural anomalies are not being tolerated by them." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Procedural anomalies would not be tolerated by them." – Incorrect modal verb (uses "would" instead of "will").
 
• **Option 4: **"Procedural anomalies have not been tolerated by them." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
